headline: The U.S. retaliates against a 'surprise attack' by Iran in Jordan
context: The U.S. attacks were in retaliation for what the U.S. Central Command called "an attempted surprise attack" with ballistic missiles on Tuesday against U.S. forces in the Middle East.
